regime_context: Eligible trend themes are concentrated in AI Compute & Optics and Semiconductors, both in uptrends with decent durability. Innovative Pharma is also eligible but crowded. The absolute-trend gate historically did not reduce drawdown in this market (gate_helps=false), so the discipline is experimental here. Past high-conviction calls have missed. All leans carry low confidence.
emerging_watch: Watch for a confirmed leadership handoff to Semiconductors if the rotation margin (currently 0.17) narrows below 0.10 and Semiconductors maintains its trend gate (durability>0.5) while AI Compute breaches its trend gate. This is not a call; it is a watch for a potential regime shift.

theses.subject: AI Compute & Optics
theses.thesis: AI Compute & Optics is the leading theme per rank and trend eligibility, not crowded. The trend gate is satisfied (durability_bar 0.55 > 0.5), and breadth is positive but narrow. In a trend-following framework, this suggests maintaining exposure as long as the trend continues. However, cross-sectional momentum has no return edge, and the trend gate did not historically cut drawdown in this market, so the lean is strictly conditional on the trend persisting.
theses.dissent: Mean-reversion risk in a market where trend gate historically failed to protect; momentum rank may be a coincident peak indicator. If the AI narrative fades or regulatory headwinds emerge, the theme could reverse sharply.

falsifier.text: Close below the 50-day moving average of ETF proxy 515000.SS for two consecutive days, or durability_bar drops below 0.5 (trend gate flips false).

macro_narrative.note: market-level macro/policy/geo narrative flow; coincident, not per-theme, never a trigger
